correctness.rationale: The proof reconstructs exact affected-interval union rates for lengths 2m, 2m+1 and one site, verifies bounded-hierarchy uniqueness by repeated integration, and derives a closed A/B0/B1 ODE. The two singular integrals are separated; bounded convergence after the slow time substitution gives e^{-2} for positive rates, not zero. The packaged checker validates 32 exact geometric coefficient identities, boundary limits, homogeneous rate, and seeded finite cycles. Finite simulations are not the infinite-volume proof.

value.rationale: A fixed-width lattice trimer system with physically motivated period-two impinging flux shows a discontinuous, nonzero change in terminal vacancy when the absent species has arbitrarily small positive rate, including a precise jump 3e^{-2}/2. This identifies an ordering-of-limits pathology important for kinetics on patterned surfaces and a three-variable exact benchmark. Not merely a textbook homogeneous trimer evaluation or arbitrary numerical slice.
